session_note: Retrieved on 2026-10-09 while upgrading the abstract-only stubs KN-LIT-fa389d (Menezes-Teske-Weng, Weak Fields for ECC) and KN-LIT-3305 (Menezes-Teske, Cryptographic implications of Hess' generalized GHS attack) to full-read entries. eprint.iacr.org served a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge for the HTML and PDF URLs of both papers (HTTP 403 through the WebFetch tool; a 'Just a moment...' challenge page through curl), so the ePrint PDFs could not be retrieved. The PostScript of 2003/128 was served normally, and the companion paper was taken from the authors' own CACR technical-report copy (CORR 2004-25, which the ePrint 2004/235 record mirrors). PostScript files were converted with Ghostscript 10.02.1 (ps2pdf) and pdftotext -layout; the Type-3 fonts in the 2003/128 PostScript drop the glyphs c, ff, fi, fl from the text extraction, so the .txt files in this package are search aids and the .ps/.pdf files are the record. Licences: ePrint 2003/128 is listed under CC BY on its ePrint record (as reported by a web search result; the record page itself could not be fetched); CORR 2004-25 and the ECC 2003 slides are author-hosted on cacr.uwaterloo.ca; arXiv:1807.01858 is under the arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence. Vendored for the same reason as inputs/JMV-0411378-20260907: so the claims in the KN-LIT entries can be checked against frozen bytes without a second network fetch.
